title: Accessibility certification (WCAG 2.2 AA + Braille pipeline + dyslexia/Irlen presets visible)
description: Make the existing accessibility infra defensible: ship a WCAG 2.2 AA conformance audit + visible badge on every worksheet; surface Plain-English Flesch–Kincaid score with a one-click rewrite; bake dyslexia / Irlen / ADHD / autism overlay presets into print + digital with school-wide defaults; add one-click large-print (24pt single-column) AND a UEB Braille pipeline.
rationale: User's improvement #10. The accessibility-profiles infra already exists (PR #30 FEAT-010); this PR turns 'we have profiles' into 'we are the only UK generator that ships WCAG-certified output and a Braille pipeline.' That distinction is decisive for SEND/EHCP procurement.
constraints: WCAG audit MUST run client-side with no third-party tooling (axe-core is fine — already MIT — but no SaaS).
Braille pipeline uses liblouis-wasm bundled (Apache-2.0); no external API.
Conformance badge ONLY shown when the per-render audit passes; never a static claim.
School-wide defaults stored on the school record (PC2 added schools table); falls back to org-default if not set.
steps: Add `axe-core` as a dep (already used by some test suites — verify; otherwise add). Create client/src/lib/wcagAuditor.ts: auditWorksheetElement(element): { passed: boolean; violations: { id; impact; description; nodes }[] }. Runs axe against the rendered WorksheetRenderer DOM in pupil view + teacher view modes.

Add audit pass to WorksheetRenderer post-mount: useEffect runs auditWorksheetElement, stamps result onto a context (so other components can read it). When passed, render a small 'WCAG 2.2 AA' chip in the footer (pupil view + teacher view); when failed, render an amber chip with click-to-expand violations. Print + PDF show only the passing badge or no badge.
- client/src/lib/plainEnglishCheck.ts: { fk: number; level: 'easy'|'ok'|'difficult'; suggestions: string[] } from existing FK helper.

- WorksheetRenderer: small chip 'Reading age 14 · Grade 9' next to the WCAG badge. Click → opens a 'Rewrite at lower reading age' dialog that calls aiAdjustReadingLevel (already exists in ai.ts) on the visible content.

- accessibility-profiles.ts already has 8 profiles. Promote the Irlen-stress, ADHD, and autism presets to first-class entries (currently buried). Add a 'School default profile' setting on Settings → Tenant. Apply on every page load if no per-user override is set.

- One-click '24pt single-column' button on the Worksheet Typography picker. Renders the same content with `accessibility-profiles.ts` 'large-print' profile applied AND triggers print/PDF in single-column layout (override pdf-generator-v2's grid).

- client/src/lib/braillePipeline.ts: worksheetToBrl(worksheet): Promise<string> using liblouis-wasm with the 'unified-english-braille' table. Diagrams produce TACTILE-DESCRIBE prose alternatives (hooked to existing accessibility-profiles 'screen-reader-clean' pass).
- 'Export Braille (BRF)' button on the Typography picker. BRF is the standard Braille embosser format — ships as a downloadable file, named .brf.
- docs/accessibility/conformance-statement.md — WCAG 2.2 AA conformance statement template referencing the per-render audit + the per-tenant school defaults. Linked from the badge tooltip.
- client/src/lib/__tests__/wcagAuditor.test.ts — covers: passing render vs. fixture with deliberately-low contrast vs. missing-label fixture.
- client/src/lib/__tests__/braillePipeline.test.ts — round-trips a simple worksheet through liblouis-wasm and asserts BRF byte signature.
- Snapshot of the badge in passed vs failed states.
files_to_touch: client/src/components/A11yPickerDialog.tsx (Large print + Braille buttons; rename if a different file already exists)
do_not_touch: Existing accessibility-profiles 8-profile registry (only add — never remove)
Pupil Companion accessibility hookups (PR #32) — surfacing the audit there is a follow-up
acceptance_criteria: Every successful worksheet render shows a WCAG 2.2 AA badge.
Deliberate violations (axe-core fixtures) flip the badge to amber and surface the rule that failed.
FK plain-English chip appears + the rewrite dialog produces lower-reading-age content.
Large-print mode renders 24pt single-column in print preview.
Braille BRF export downloads a valid file that loads in a free Braille viewer (manual check).
School-default accessibility profile applies to a new pupil in that school.
pnpm run check + pnpm run build + pnpm test --run pass.
verification: pnpm run build (check bundle delta — liblouis-wasm is ~ 200kb gzipped, lazy-load it)
Manual: open a worksheet, confirm badge; open Typography picker, click Large print → print preview; click Braille → BRF downloads.

size_estimate.notes: Above 600 — split into PC7a (audit + plain English) + PC7b (Braille + Large print) for fresh chats.

context_budget_for_fresh_chat: MEDIUM. accessibility-profiles.ts is small. WorksheetRenderer must be touched only via additive footer chips.
